title: Carbonium
description: Carbonium is a comprehensive Minecraft mod that adds carbon-themed materials, tools, weapons, armor, and achievements. The mod includes both craftable items and new blocks added directly into the game.
body:
Carbonium Mod

Carbonium is a comprehensive Minecraft mod that adds carbon-themed materials, tools, weapons, armor, and achievements. The mod includes both craftable items and new blocks added directly into the game.

-New Materials & Blocks 
-New Tools & Weapons 
-Armor 
-Crafting Recipes 
-Achievements 
-Creative Tab
